name: P-40 Warhawk
summary: Early-WWII American fighter flown by the Flying Tigers; around two dozen fly in the US, often in shark-mouth markings.

wings: Low wing with rounded tips and pronounced dihedral
Main gear retracts rearward into the wing
engines: Inline V-12 with a deep chin radiator scoop right behind the propeller
fuselage: Framed canopy with a tall rear deck
Often painted with a shark-mouth on the chin

tellTales: Deep radiator scoop under the nose, right behind the propeller
Shark-mouth paint on the chin is common
Rounded tail and wingtips with a framed canopy

confusedWith.howToTell: The Mustang's radiator scoop is under the belly behind the cockpit; the P-40's is under the nose.

usCount.source: warbirdregistry.org P-40 registry (28 airworthy-coded worldwide) cross-checked with FAA registry (~44 registered)
